summary: Clear, useful support email. Optional low-priority improvement: group the refund scope with its pending status, then end with the promised update and fallback. Conventional courtesy is not itself a defect.
known_origin: New AI-authored synthetic evaluation source; not real user/company history

measurement.caution: Experimental uncalibrated English class outputs, not authorship probabilities or word shares. The saved 36-document pilot includes high-confidence false positives.

paragraphs.quote: Thank you for your patience while I reviewed the duplicate charge on order R-214. I confirmed that the second payment was taken on 18 September. I submitted a refund request for £36 this morning, but the payment team has not approved it yet. I understand why seeing two charges would be frustrating, and I am sorry for the extra work this has caused you.

If the team approves the request, the money should reach the original card within five working days. That is an estimate, not a guaranteed arrival date. There is no need for you to submit another form while the request is pending.

I will email you by 3 p.m. on Friday even if I am still waiting for a decision. If you do not receive that update, please reply to this email with the order number. I cannot cancel the first payment because the order has already shipped. The refund request covers only the duplicate £36 payment.

occlusion.interpretation: Sensitivity to deleting a paragraph. Positive delta means removal lowered the score; length/context changes confound this. This is not causal authorship evidence or a sentence probability.

revise.issue: P4 returns from follow-up instructions to refund scope.
revise.action: Optionally place the first-payment/shipped explanation and duplicate-only scope beside request status. Finish with the Friday update and missing-update fallback.
revise.success: A customer can find current status, conditional timing, and next contact without backtracking; all facts and duties stay intact.

revise.issue: Thanks plus explicit empathy plus apology make the opening relatively long.
revise.action: Lightly tighten the courteous framing only if the result still acknowledges frustration and apologizes for the extra work. No need to add slang or an invented personal detail.
revise.success: Status arrives sooner without becoming cold or losing the apology.
